# Machu Picchu daily pool tracker

Logs the 1,000 same-cycle entry tickets for the Llaqta de Machupicchu, so we can
answer one question properly: **for a given visit date, what time did each route
sell out, and how many days ahead was it?** Source: the public availability
board at `tuboleto.cultura.pe/disponibilidad/llaqta_machupicchu`.

## Running it

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
playwright install chromium

python scrape.py                      # one poll
python scrape.py --debug              # plus screenshot, HTML and raw captures
python scrape.py --loop 25 --every 5  # poll every 5 min for 25 min
python summarize.py                   # regenerate the Summary section above
```

Full technical details (API signing, why we drive a real browser instead of
forging requests, data schema, known open problems) live in `CLAUDE.md`.
